title: posthog-cli update: only script installs whose receipt prefix contains the running binary self-update
answers: Why does posthog-cli update print a command instead of updating?
How does posthog-cli decide whether it installed itself via install script?
Debug build started self-updating and overwrote ~/.posthog
body:
Install classification lives in `cli/src/update.rs:classify_path` (called by `detect_install_method`).
- A receipt existing is NOT proof of ownership. `owned_by_script` is true only when the receipt's `install_prefix` (via `receipt_install_prefix`) contains the canonicalized running exe. Otherwise a debug build or package-manager copy would be 'updated' from a stale receipt.
- Path checks win over the receipt: `Cellar` -> Homebrew, `node_modules` -> Npm(path), parent `.cargo/bin` -> Cargo, then script, else Unknown.
- Use `std::fs::canonicalize`, not `read_link`: Homebrew symlinks are relative (`../Cellar/...`).
- npm is ONE variant (`InstallMethod::Npm(PathBuf)`); global, npx and plugin/SDK-nested copies all get a message naming the path. Do not split it.
- Any new `InstallMethod` variant must return guidance from `InstallMethod::guidance`; `only_a_script_install_updates_itself` guards this.
applies: cli/src/update.rs install detection and the `posthog-cli update` command
